output_mount.pattern: Uniform 31 mm grid of overlapping NEMA17 patterns

plastic_thread_seats.method: Three axial rounded ribs at 120 degrees, with tapered entry. Unformed rib/shaft overlap is intentional and bounded to each verified rib solid. Thread forming and stripping torque are not simulated.

carrier_heat_set_inserts.installation: Heat set into the loose carrier before assembling it. Inserts stay bonded to the carrier during adjustment and exploded disassembly. STL uses Ø6.4 mm pilots; assembly cavity represents displaced plastic.

specification.installation: Pinch the split retaining head and slide the bearing on while supporting its inner race. The tapered relief slot and root clearance allow inward flex. Insertion force and strain are not validated; the viewer shows the undeformed geometry.

split_axles.note: Split Ø4.8 mm journals retain the existing 6.4 mm head and 30-degree bent tip. Tapered slots end in a 0.6 mm radius; deep root clearance frees both prongs. Passing the bearing bore over the head requires inward flex; force, strain and retention are not simulated.

smooth_running_faces.note: Raised side rails are removed. Checks cover nominal bearing geometry and +/-1 mm axial displacement relative to the carriage, not bearing tilt, preload or printed surface friction. Existing support clearance channels are retained.

specification.base_backing: Retained below structural feet; otherwise open

lid_and_attachment.base_backing: Retained below structural feet; otherwise open
lid_and_attachment.floor_mount_type: M3 insert seats entered from underside

cutout_planning.note: Window bounds are non-overlapping and separated by at least 6 mm. Complete insert/support bands and rounded windows replace overlapping or clipped legacy patterns. This checks planned webs, not a universal minimum-wall or structural-strength certification.

bearing_support_feet.note: The four bearing-support undersides are coplanar with the adjacent adjustment-bolt shelves. This removes the local four-millimetre recess; it is not a claim that the whole print requires no supports.

adjustable_bearings.mechanism: Four top-entry M5x25 bolts bear on fixed shelves and pull one rigid carrier holding all lower bearings upward into M5 heat-set inserts; nominal contact at 1 mm. Tighten evenly. No elastic preload or carrier tilt is simulated.

running_faces.coverage: Full travel plus the entire 8 mm bearing radius at both limits

guidance.carriage_type: moving hollow triangular tube with internal flange nut
guidance.note: At nominal contact, the two triangles provide rank-5 constraint, leaving X translation free. This is not a stiffness or load rating.

base_mount_access.hole_type: Ø4 mm printed pilot; backing retained beneath structural feet

explosion.note: Staged disassembly with synchronized screw rotation. Undeformed retaining heads visibly intersect their own bearing bores during snap removal/insertion. These exact head contacts are recorded separately; every other collision fails. No elastic bending is animated or validated. Thread rib contact is bounded separately.

limits: Geometry prototype; no stress, stiffness, fatigue or physical fit validation.
T8 screw and nut use smooth fit envelopes; helical thread engagement, backlash and friction are not simulated.
Motor and purchased hardware dimensions are reference assumptions; confirm actual parts. No external screw-support bearings are modeled.
Bearing-block adjustment is rigid translation; clamp force, stiffness and print creep require physical testing.
Three-ridge pilot dimensions are prototype values; test forming torque and pull-out with the actual screw and print material. Unformed ridge overlap is intentional, not a simulated formed thread.
